headline: Interest Rates Still Under Upward Pressure, But the Pace Has Slowed
summary: A State Bank of Vietnam deputy governor said interest rates are still under upward pressure but the pace of increase is slowing. The average deposit rate for new transactions was 6.38% a year as of 20 September, up 1.15 points from end-2025.
why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy, and deposit and lending rates shape credit demand and the outlook for Vietnamese bank earnings.
